Page 1: Company Overview
Nexora Dynamics Pvt. Ltd. is a B2B software company founded on 14 March 2014 by Aarav Mehta and Vikram Rao.
The company is headquartered at Sector 44, Gurugram, Haryana, and operates three additional offices: Bengaluru
(Whitefield), Pune (Hinjewadi) and Hyderabad (HITEC City). As of 31 March 2026 the company had 412 employees
across eight departments.
Products
Nexora sells three products. NexaFlow is a workflow automation platform and the oldest product, launched in 2015.
NexaSense is an analytics and business-intelligence suite launched in 2018. NexaGuard is a security and zero-trust

NexaSense is an analytics and business-intelligence suite launched in 2018. NexaGuard is a security and zero-trust
access product launched in 2021. NexaFlow contributes 48% of annual revenue, NexaSense 32% and NexaGuard
20%.
Mission and values
The company's stated mission is to help mid-sized enterprises automate repetitive work safely. Its four core values are
Customer Obsession, Ownership, Craft, and Candour. The internal motto printed on every employee badge is 'Ship it,
then sharpen it.'

History
In 2015 the company shipped NexaFlow v1.0 to its first customer, Orbitek Logistics. The Gurugram office moved to its
current Sector 44 location in 2017. The Bengaluru office opened in 2016, Pune in 2019 and Hyderabad in 2021. In
August 2023 Nexora closed its Series B round. The company has never been acquired and has no plans to go public
before 2029.

Engineering practices
All engineering teams follow two-week sprints that begin on Mondays. Code reviews require two approvals before
merge into the main branch. The minimum unit-test coverage threshold enforced by the CI pipeline is 80%. Production
deployments are frozen between 20 December and 2 January each year. The on-call rotation is weekly and on-call
engineers receive an allowance of INR 6,000 per rotation week.
Customer Support operates in three shifts to cover customers in multiple time zones. The first-response SLA for Priority

Customer Support operates in three shifts to cover customers in multiple time zones. The first-response SLA for Priority
1 tickets is 30 minutes, for Priority 2 tickets 4 hours, and for Priority 3 tickets 1 business day. Customer Support
handled 41,300 tickets in FY2025-26 with a customer satisfaction (CSAT) score of 92.4%.
Sales targets: the Sales department closed 138 new enterprise contracts in FY2025-26 against a target of 120. The
average contract value was INR 38 lakh.

Project descriptions
Project Atlas migrates the monolithic NexaFlow application into microservices running on Kubernetes. It is the largest
project by budget. The project team has 22 engineers. Its main risk is data-migration downtime for customers on legacy
on-premise installations.
Project Helios builds a real-time analytics engine for NexaSense, targeting sub-second query latency on datasets of
up to 5 billion rows. The project was originally due on 30 September 2026 but fell behind because of delays in
provisioning ClickHouse clusters. The team has 17 engineers.
Project Zephyr rolled out zero-trust network access for NexaGuard enterprise clients. It was completed on 28 March

Project Zephyr rolled out zero-trust network access for NexaGuard enterprise clients. It was completed on 28 March
2026, two days ahead of schedule and under budget, with final spend of INR 2.94 crore against INR 3.10 crore
approved.
Project Orion is an LLM-powered customer support chatbot. It uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with a
hybrid of keyword and vector search over the company's help-centre articles, and a nine-person team. During the pilot
the chatbot resolved 31% of tickets without human handover. The target resolution rate for general release is 45%.
Combined approved budget of the four projects is INR 11.00 crore. Atlas and Orion are both scheduled to finish before

Combined approved budget of the four projects is INR 11.00 crore. Atlas and Orion are both scheduled to finish before
the end of calendar year 2026; Helios's revised timeline is recorded in the announcements log on page 10.

Leave policy
Every full-time employee is entitled to 24 days of paid leave per calendar year, made up of 18 days of earned leave and
6 days of casual leave. Sick leave is separate and is 10 days per year with a medical certificate required for absences
longer than two consecutive days. Up to 12 days of earned leave may be carried forward to the next year; unused
casual leave lapses on 31 December. Maternity leave is 26 weeks and paternity leave is 10 working days.
Working hours and remote work
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with core collaboration hours of 11:00 AM to 4:00

Working hours and remote work
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday, with core collaboration hours of 11:00 AM to 4:00
PM. Under the hybrid policy in this version, employees may work from home up to 2 days per week with prior manager
approval. Employees who work remotely receive an internet reimbursement of INR 1,000 per month.
Notice period and probation
New hires serve a probation period of 6 months. An employee who resigns must serve a notice period of 60 days if
below Manager level, or 90 days if at Manager level or above. The company may waive part of the notice period at the
discretion of the department head and the CHRO. Outstanding leave is not encashable during probation.

Benefits
Health insurance: every employee is covered under a group health policy with a family floater sum insured of INR 5
lakh. Employees may add parents or parents-in-law for an additional INR 3 lakh of cover at their own cost. An
accidental death and disability cover of INR 25 lakh applies to all staff.
Provident fund: both employer and employee contribute 12% of basic salary.
Learning budget: each employee gets INR 40,000 per financial year for courses, books and certifications, and may
carry no unused balance forward.
ESOP: employees become eligible for stock options after completing 2 years of service. Options vest over 4 years with
a 1-year cliff, meaning no options vest before the first anniversary of the grant.

Referral bonus: INR 30,000 for a successful referral into any role, and INR 50,000 for referrals into engineering roles,
paid after the referred hire completes 6 months of service.
Wellness: a monthly wellness allowance of INR 1,500 is paid to every employee and may be used for gym
memberships, yoga classes or mental-health counselling. The company also provides free lunch on Wednesdays in all
four offices.
Appraisal cycle
Appraisals happen twice a year. The mid-year review takes place in October and the annual review in April, with
revised salaries effective from 1 May. Ratings use a five-point scale: 1 (Needs Improvement), 2 (Developing), 3 (Meets

revised salaries effective from 1 May. Ratings use a five-point scale: 1 (Needs Improvement), 2 (Developing), 3 (Meets
Expectations), 4 (Exceeds Expectations), 5 (Outstanding). Individual salaries are confidential and are not part of this
data book.

Operational incident report
On 9 May 2026 a major outage affected NexaFlow customers hosted in the ap-south-1 region. The outage lasted 3
hours and 42 minutes, beginning at 02:17 IST. The root cause was an expired TLS certificate on an internal API
gateway. 61 customers were affected and service credits totalling INR 18.4 lakh were issued. As a corrective action,
Platform and Infra (led by Gaurav Tiwari) introduced automated certificate expiry alerts 30 days before expiry.

Platform and Infra (led by Gaurav Tiwari) introduced automated certificate expiry alerts 30 days before expiry.
Compliance: Nexora holds ISO 27001 certification, first obtained in 2021 and renewed in November 2025, and a SOC 2
Type II report covering NexaGuard. The next ISO surveillance audit is planned for November 2026.
